title: Where to eat
intro: Plan a meal across Odisha’s cities, coastal stops and southern hills. Start with Odia dining, explore other cuisines, and use the visit notes to choose a place that fits your route.
note: This directory draws on restaurants’ own information; it is not a rating or a service-quality audit. Confirm menus, opening hours, prices and dietary requirements directly. For hotel and resort restaurants, check whether non-residents can dine before making a special trip.

venues.name: Odraa Dine
venues.description: Odia cooking with contemporary presentation and pairings, drawing on coastal, western and southern Odisha. Founded by Tallina Patnaik and Tanaya Patnaik.
venues.menu_note: Menu linked by the restaurant. We could not read the Google Drive file; confirm current dishes and prices directly.

venues.name: Dining at Hotel Signature

venues.description: The hotel’s restaurant offers Odia, Indian and continental dishes in Nehru Nagar.

venues.name: Mosaic at Empires Paradeep

venues.description: Dining at Hotel Sea Pearl in Udaybat, with Indian, Middle Eastern and Oriental food advertised by the hotel.

venues.name: Naivaidyam at The Mohini Royale
venues.description: The Mohini Royale lists Naivaidyam as its restaurant near the railway-station and market area.

venues.description: Apoorva Royale’s in-house restaurant offers a place to sit down for a meal in Balangir.

venues.name: Restaurant at Swayam Hotel & Resort
venues.description: A hotel-and-resort dining option on Sambalpur Road, with arrangements for meals and gatherings.

venues.name: Restaurant at Shakti Continental

venues.name: Restaurant at Nirupama Dhenkanal
venues.description: Nirupama’s Dhenkanal property advertises Odia meals alongside its broader restaurant offering.

venues.name: Shakti Restaurant at Hotel Durga
venues.description: Hotel Durga’s restaurant advertises biryanis, tandoori kebabs and curries in Sankhapata.

venues.name: Soukheen at Hotel Orion
venues.description: A hotel family restaurant advertising Indian, Chinese, tandoori and Continental meals.

venues.name: The Royal Leaf at Hotel Royal Palace
venues.description: A multi-cuisine restaurant whose website lists mutton kasa, biryani, Indian curries and noodles.

venues.name: Restaurant at Hotel Jyoti Mahal
venues.description: A multi-cuisine hotel restaurant in Rayagada’s New Colony area.

venues.name: Restaurant at Hotel Amrapali Classic
venues.description: A multi-cuisine hotel restaurant in Hilltown, with private dining arrangements advertised by the hotel.

venues.name: Paradise Restro
venues.area: Utkal Centre Point, third floor, Byasanagar
venues.description: North Indian curries, tandoori dishes, biryani and Indo-Chinese choices at Utkal Centre Point.

venues.name: Odisha Hotel — Sahid Nagar
venues.area: C-18, Sahid Nagar Market Building, near BMC Bhawani Mall
venues.description: A restaurant specialising in Odia cooking, with vegetarian and non-vegetarian choices.
venues.visitor_note: This entry is for Sahid Nagar. Use the operator’s branch list if another neighbourhood fits your day better.

venues.name: Nimantran — Bhubaneswar
venues.description: OTDC’s restaurant brings together Odia cooking from different regions of the state.
venues.visitor_note: The operator lists parking and a waiting area. Confirm directions with the restaurant; OTDC’s Lewis Road footer is its head office.

venues.name: Holiday Palms at Hotel Holiday Resort
venues.description: Odia specialities and desserts alongside seafood, Indian and continental dishes.
venues.visitor_note: A choice on Chakratirtha Road for a group wanting both Odia and other cuisines. Contact the restaurant about dining if you are not staying at the hotel.

venues.name: Restaurant at Lotus Eco Beach Resort
venues.area: Khalkatapatna, near Ramachandi Temple, Puri–Konark Marine Drive
venues.description: Multi-cuisine dining at Lotus Eco Beach Resort on the Puri–Konark route.
venues.visitor_note: The restaurant is near Ramachandi, outside Konark town. Plan it as a road stop and confirm dining access before making a special trip.

venues.name: Orana at Swosti Chilika Resort
venues.description: Seafood and a multi-cuisine menu, with air-conditioned dining and outdoor lawn seating.
venues.visitor_note: Use the Bejiput address when planning your route. Ask about a table for non-resident diners and whether the buffet is running that day.

venues.name: Yummies Restaurant
venues.description: Indian, tandoori and Chinese food, with seafood choices including fish, prawns and crab.
venues.visitor_note: A beach-area option for lunch or dinner, with a rooftop dining area. The restaurant recommends booking ahead; check rooftop opening times when calling.

venues.name: 1914 Dining Room at Mayfair Palm Beach Resort
venues.description: Pan-Asian dining with buffet and à la carte choices; the operator also highlights seafood.
venues.visitor_note: A resort dining option for a longer sit-down meal. Ask which service is available and confirm access if you are visiting just for food.

venues.name: Kedia’s Restaurant
venues.description: A standalone restaurant serving Indian, Chinese and tandoor dishes, with biryani and pizza also listed on its website.
venues.visitor_note: The website separates Kedia’s Restaurant from Dhaba by Kedia’s. Use the Budharaja restaurant contact when planning your visit.
venues.menu_note: Operator menu; availability and prices may change.

venues.name: Yavis Restaurant
venues.area: Firewood Depot, near CT Market, Sector 4
venues.description: A restaurant with Indian, Chinese and Continental choices, including vegetarian and meat dishes, thali lunches, pizza and Lebanese items.
venues.visitor_note: Browse the itemised online menu and use the website’s table-booking option for a group meal.
venues.menu_note: Operator menu; availability and prices may change.

venues.name: The Marinated
venues.description: A standalone restaurant listing biryanis, mutton kadhai, chicken dishes and paneer lasuni tikka.
venues.visitor_note: The operator lists separate lunch and dinner service. Contact the restaurant for current availability before making a special trip.

venues.name: Bojanam
venues.area: First floor, City Palace Building, Bijipur Main Road, near Christian Hospital
venues.description: A vegetarian South Indian restaurant serving dosas, idlis, banana-leaf thalis and filter coffee.
venues.visitor_note: The restaurant is on the first floor and advertises two- and four-wheeler parking. Ask about step-free access if needed; its menu also offers Jain and no-onion, no-garlic preparations on request.
venues.menu_note: Operator menu; availability and prices may change.

venues.name: Yum Chinese
venues.area: O.T. Road, opposite Ori-Plast, near Laxmi Narayan Temple, Alupur
venues.description: An O.T. Road restaurant listing noodles, fried rice, crispy chilli baby corn and chicken dishes.
venues.visitor_note: The website provides a direct number for delivery and bulk orders, alongside its menu link.

venues.name: Super Snax at Mayfair Oasis
venues.description: A vegetarian restaurant serving South Indian food and snacks, including dosa and chaat, at Mayfair Oasis.
venues.visitor_note: The operator lists both indoor and outdoor seating. Use the hotel front-office contact to confirm restaurant access and current service.

venues.name: VDumpling Dynasty — Cuttack
venues.description: The Cuttack outlet of a locally founded momo and Pan-Asian food business, with dumplings, noodles, fried rice and soups on its menu.
venues.visitor_note: The operator lists the Cuttack branch in Sector 9, CDA. Its published contact serves the brand; confirm this outlet’s seating and service before visiting.

venues.name: Chilika island breakfast — Rambha Palace
venues.description: A morning boat outing arranged by Rambha Palace, with breakfast aboard and an optional island walk. Ask whether the route includes Breakfast Island in Rambha Bay.
venues.visitor_note: Arrange this with the palace in advance. Confirm the island and departure point, whether non-residents can join, the menu, price, boat arrangements and weather-dependent landing. The operator’s dining page does not name the island or promise a meal served ashore.
